name: Robylon
tagline: AI agents resolve customer support across email, chat, voice, SMS and WhatsApp.
description: Robylon is an AI customer-support platform. Its agents work across email, chat, voice, SMS and WhatsApp, connect to helpdesk and CRM tools, and complete workflows such as refunds, order updates and ticket handling. They hand unresolved issues to a human with full context. Most teams go live in about a week. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant; EU and US data hosting.
